notes: Read in full: the Finance rail pages (operations, pipeline, commissions, reports, both previews), the Accounts Setup finance editors (Commission & Payouts, Document Numbering, PO Settings, Payment Methods, Project & Payments), Document Templates, Legal Entities, the accounting settings UI and README, and the dashboard’s finance cards; the report and accounting API internals were read for their rules only, nothing was run. Expense categories, PO thresholds and the vendor / PO / bill / expense screens are left to the money-out map, and the project’s money-in screens to the money-in map. Dead 1.0 code skipped: the finance CSV export API (no caller), the bulk Generate Invoices dialog and its double-entry journal lines, the unreachable project “Financial Report” dialog and the Proactive Alerts tab. The F2 record (f2-read.md) says the Tax report’s GST lines “live in P&L”, but 2.0’s P&L is before GST, so no screen shows GST collected or paid (REG-1307 dropped the Tax view). The Dashboard is held (N-02), so 1.0’s studio-wide money glance has no single home today.
